map.使用 Canvas API 对图片进行像素化/马赛克处理，支持全图或区域框选，实: Pixelate and mosaic images using the Canvas API, over the whole image or a selected region, with live preview and pure front-end processing with no upload.
map.点击或拖拽图片到这里: Click or drag an image here
map.支持 JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF 等格式，图片仅在浏览器本地处: Supports JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF and more; images are processed locally in your browser only
map.在图片上按住拖拽即可框选要打码的区域；可反复拖拽调整，松手自动生效。: Press and drag on the image to select the region to pixelate; you can drag repeatedly to adjust, and it takes effect when you release.
map.本工具纯前端运行，图片数据不会上传到任何服务器: This tool runs entirely in the front end and image data is never uploaded to any server
map.区域马赛克模式下，在图片上拖拽即可框选打码区域，松手后实时生效: In region mosaic mode, drag on the image to select the area to pixelate; it takes effect in real time when you release
map.像素块越大马赛克越明显，越小越精细；建议 8~30px 之间效果较佳: The larger the pixel block the stronger the mosaic and the smaller the block the more refined; 8~30px usually gives the best result
map.下载 PNG 为无损画质，JPEG 文件更小但有压缩，按需选择: Downloading PNG is lossless, while JPEG gives a smaller file with compression; choose as needed
map.截图里遮挡手机号、身份证、人脸等隐私区域。: Mask private areas such as phone numbers, ID numbers and faces in screenshots.
map.做艺术像素化效果，不暴露细节。: Create an artistic pixelation effect without exposing detail.
map.块大小 10px 打码: Pixelate a face with a 10px block
map.选人脸区域，块大小 10px，区域内每 10×10 像素取平均色填充，远处看已无: Select the face region with a 10px block size and fill each 10×10 pixel area with its average colour; from a distance the facial features are no longer recognisable.
map.敏感文字区块大小 20px，模糊更强，连笔画都难还原，适合强隐私场景。: For sensitive text blocks use a 20px block size, which blurs more heavily and even strokes are hard to reconstruct, suiting high-privacy scenarios.
map.是的。块大小越大单格覆盖像素越多，原信息越难还原；10px 已能遮脸，20px: Yes. A larger block covers more pixels per cell, so the original information is harder to reconstruct; 10px is already enough to cover a face, and 20px suits text.
map.单向像素平均不可逆，导出后原细节丢失，发布前确认打码范围足够。: One-way pixel averaging is irreversible, so the original detail is lost after export; confirm the masked area is large enough before publishing.
map.关于「图片马赛克效果工具」: About the Image Mosaic Effect Tool
map.图片马赛克效果工具是一款在线图像处理工具，可将图片像素化以实现打码遮挡效果。支持: The image mosaic effect tool is an online image processing tool that pixelates images to create a redaction effect. It supports whole-image mosaic and local region selection modes, lets you adjust the pixel block size with a slider and preview in real time, and can export PNG or JPEG after processing. All computation runs locally in your browser and images are never uploaded to a server, so privacy is protected.
map.全图马赛克与区域框选马赛克两种模式: Two modes: whole-image mosaic and region selection mosaic
map.像素块大小 2~50px 自由调节，实时预览: Pixel block size adjustable from 2~50px with live preview
map.支持拖拽上传与触摸框选，移动端友好: Supports drag upload and touch selection, mobile friendly
map.按原图分辨率导出 PNG/JPEG，画质无损: Exports PNG/JPEG at the original resolution with lossless quality
map.遮挡身份证、车牌、人脸等隐私信息: Mask private information such as ID numbers, licence plates and faces
map.给分享截图中的敏感内容打码: Pixelate sensitive content in shared screenshots
map.隐藏图片中的文字、水印或账号信息: Hide text, watermarks or account information in images
map.隐私敏感场景下的本地图片处理: Local image processing for privacy-sensitive scenarios
